about: The share of an industry's jobs that stand open on any day: the JOLTS job openings rate (openings over employment plus openings), the 45-month average with its range as the spread. At the opening each employer posts its standing openings from it (src/core2/modules/jobs.ts, postStandingOpenings), so a world opens with the openings a real one carries instead of none. Business kinds map to series by vacancy-duration.json's kinds.

total-private.source: BLS JOLTS job openings rate, total private, seasonally adjusted, monthly, Jan 2023 to Sep 2026 (45 months), FRED series JTS1000JOR (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/JTS1000JOR), fetched Nov 12, 2026. The rate is openings over employment plus openings.
